_comment: Public sustainability statements used to test ESG Lens on real reports. `esg-lens fetch` downloads them into data/reports/ (git-ignored: the PDFs belong to the companies). Add your own lines with the same fields.

reports.why: Mining equipment, about 80 pages: a mid-size statement, the easiest start.
Trucks. Reports Scope 1 and 2 combined and says water is not material: tests 'not disclosed'.
Cement, about 155 pages, emissions in Mt CO2e and intensity figures: the hardest case.
